description: What moved on a board, grouped by card — the call to make when resuming a session. Walks the activity log back to `since` (ISO date) or up to `limit` events. Planka logs only creation, moves, member changes and task completion.

limit.description: Maximum events to return. Default 50, max 250.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only events at or after it are returned; the sweep stops there.

name: planka_board_activity
title: Board activity
